facts.summary: Off-treatment sustained response not achieved, 39 of 41 relapsed · Phase 2 · vebicorvir in chronic hepatitis B · not yet approved

evidence.summary: HBV field's first core inhibitor combination study (Study 211) to assess off-treatment response did not achieve a meaningful rate of sustained virologic response (SVR) as 39 of 41 patients have relapsed.
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: did not achieve a meaningful rate of sustained virologic response (SVR) as 39 of 41 patients have relapsed.
